name: com.parousya.android.sdk.PRSJobIntentService
description: Android runs this job-backed service for queued Parousya Automatic Check-In work. It checks the client sign-in state, starts beacon pairing for an active session, and shows a foreground notification while it runs.
disableEffect: Queued Parousya check-in work will not run, so beacon-based check-ins and session updates will stop.
